outcomes.title: Fix duplicated brand in <title> ('… | HeyCarbo | HeyCarbo')

verification.runtime: rendered title = 'ESG- und Lieferantendaten automatisieren | HeyCarbo' (one brand)

review.reason: Single-line, surgical caller fix restoring the SEO brand-suffix contract; all gates green.

outcomes.lesson: Root cause was a contract violation: SEO owns the '| HeyCarbo' suffix, but one caller pre-appended it. Class of bug — callers duplicating responsibilities the shared component already handles. A defensive guard in SEO would prevent recurrence (see new candidate).

outcomes.title: Make SEO brand suffix idempotent + regression test

review.reason: Self-contained guard on shared SEO component; closes the duplicate-brand bug class; covered by new regression test.

outcomes.lesson: Following a contract-violation bug, hardening the shared owner (idempotent guard) + a regression test is a high-value, zero-customer-risk follow-up. Pairs naturally with the originating fix.

outcomes.title: Regression tests for helio-serializer (live, untested, pure)

review.reason: Test-only; locks payload-build correctness for the customer-facing AI assistant.

discoveredBug.title: payloadHash uses JSON.stringify array-replacer as if it sorts keys → strips nested content → cache-key collisions → stale Helio answers
discoveredBug.proposedFix: Replace JSON.stringify(stable, Object.keys(stable).sort()) with JSON.stringify(stable) (buildHelioPayload emits keys in fixed order). Then un-skip the regression test.

outcomes.lesson: Adding regression tests to untested live logic surfaces latent bugs. The test that encodes CORRECT behavior failed → real cache-correctness bug. Captured as a documented skipped test + MEDIUM approval request rather than silently changing runtime cache behavior.

outcomes.title: Remove unused Gelica font preload (landing console warning)

review.reason: Risk reassessed above LOW. Gelica IS used (marketing headings, ContactModal), but the @font-face→file mapping for Gelica-Regular.woff2 isn't cleanly resolvable by inspection; removing the preload could regress font loading on the landing. Not implemented.

outcomes.lesson: A 'remove unused preload' goal is only LOW-risk if the asset is confirmed unused. When the font IS referenced, it needs a font-loading audit (which weight/file each @font-face resolves) — promoted to a separate audit candidate.

newCandidate.title: Audit @font-face→file mapping + preloads (resolve Gelica-Regular 'preloaded but unused' warning correctly)

outcomes.title: Regression tests for de-DE number formatters (format.ts)

review.reason: Test-only; locks the locale convention + kg->t conversion behind every user-facing number.

outcomes.lesson: Empirically confirm locale output (de-DE separators) before asserting, to avoid brittle/ICU-dependent test failures.

outcomes.title: Lock GHG Protocol Scope 3 taxonomy + label lookup (scope3-categories.ts)

review.reason: Test-only; locks customer-visible GHG Scope 3 category taxonomy + upstream/downstream split shown in reports.

outcomes.lesson: Domain-standard taxonomies (GHG Protocol categories, upstream/downstream split) are high-value regression targets: standards-anchored, customer-visible, and zero-risk to lock.

outcomes.title: Fix payloadHash cache-key collision (stale Helio AI answers)

review.reason: Approved MEDIUM fix: replaced misused JSON.stringify array-replacer with full deterministic serialization; distinct dashboard states now produce distinct cache keys.

outcomes.lesson: Closed the loop: bug discovered by a regression test (tick 1) → flagged MEDIUM for approval → approved → fixed + test un-skipped. The test-first discovery made the fix safe and instantly verifiable.

outcomes.title: Lock CSV parse + header mapping + import validation (csv-parser.ts)

review.reason: Test-only; locks the pure logic behind the data-upload flow (separator detection, DE/EN header auto-map, per-row validation) — wrong behavior = bad customer data ingested.

outcomes.lesson: Data-ingestion parsers/validators are top-tier regression targets: pure, offline-testable, and directly guarding the integrity of customer data entering the product.

outcomes.title: Main Loop tick — V1.2 prioritization + non-blocking queue
outcomes.note: V1.2 applied: top goals are product (revenue/growth/marketing/security) — all MEDIUM/HIGH or connector/input-blocked → deferred to approval-queue.json (non-blocking). Remaining LOW goals are downgraded test goals (stability sufficient: typecheck+build green, 133 tests, no regressions) so not auto-shipped. Content Watchdog produced an approval-gated Scope-3 content set.
outcomes.lesson: Working as designed: once critical areas are covered, the loop stops churning tests and surfaces high-value product goals for approval instead. Net product value is now gated on connectors + your decisions, not on more test coverage.

outcomes.title: npm audit fix — clear critical+high advisories (non-breaking)

review.reason: Within-range security patch (package-lock only); cleared critical vitest + high vite/undici; only xlsx (no upstream fix) remains. Fully validated + reversible on feature branch.

outcomes.lesson: Distinguished a non-breaking, validated, reversible SECURITY patch (LOW) from a behavior-changing dependency UPGRADE (MEDIUM). The Health Watchdog → Main Loop handoff worked: top finding became the auto-shipped goal next tick.

outcomes.title: Main Loop tick (post-UX-watchdog) — V1.2 non-blocking
outcomes.note: UX Watchdog (score 80) surfaced seo-meta-pages (M), ux-token-migration (M/L), accent (H) → deferred to queue. No safe LOW product goal auto-implementable (UI head changes need browser verify; token migration is large). Security fix shipped earlier today was the period's autonomous win.
outcomes.lesson: The LOW-risk product backlog is genuinely drained without (a) user approvals/decisions, (b) a social/calendar connector, or (c) browser-verified UI work. Recommend the user approve a queue item or authorize a low-risk product class (e.g., SEO-meta additions) to unblock autonomous throughput.

outcomes.title: Idle-gated tick — reduced cadence, dead-code safety
actions: Main Loop cron 15min → hourly (dd961231) to stop idle compute burn
outcomes.lesson: Modules with 0 importers are NOT automatically dead code — decarb-simulator/climate-benchmark/data-lineage/product-hotspot-engine are likely planned (not-yet-wired) product features. Never auto-delete work you didn't create; surface as a finding instead. Also: when a non-blocking loop becomes decision-gated, the right move is to slow the cadence (avoid wasted compute) — not churn low-value work or re-dump an unchanged queue.

outcomes.title: Patch xlsx — SheetJS 0.20.3 CDN build (approved)
outcomes.lesson: Smallest-change beat a full library swap: the advisory's 'no fix available' meant 'not on npm' — SheetJS ships the patched build via CDN. Repointing closed both CVEs with the identical API and zero code change across 5 call sites. HeyCarbo now at 0 vulnerabilities.

outcomes.title: LinkedIn/Instagram social connectors (approved)
outcomes.lesson: Built the connector adapter + routing + publish-gating (canPublish, credential-gated) honestly — but real publishing is blocked by the absence of a LinkedIn/Instagram API/OAuth credentials in the environment. Delivered the integration surface; flagged the external credential dependency rather than fabricating publishing.

outcomes.title: Add <SEO> to HelioMarketingPage (authorized LOW)
outcomes.lesson: Watchdog heuristics need verification before action: the UX watchdog flagged 5 pages for 'missing SEO meta', but 4 already render <SEO> (the flag was triggered by a redundant document.title, not a real gap). Only HelioMarketingPage was genuinely missing it. Investigating each before changing avoided 4 unnecessary edits — and replacing imperative meta with <SEO> prevented a duplicate-description-tag regression.

outcomes.title: SubpageLayout renders <SEO> → og/twitter across 38 public pages
outcomes.lesson: Biggest SEO lever was a SHARED LAYOUT, not 41 individual pages. The grep-for-<SEO> heuristic over-counted because SEO lives in ComplianceSubpage/SubpageLayout. Auditing the layout layer first turned '41 page edits' into ONE faithful, high-leverage change covering 38 pages — and avoided duplicate-meta regressions. Always audit shared layouts before per-page SEO work.

outcomes.title: Conversion sprint: connector setup docs + dual-CTA verification
outcomes.verified: Landing dual-CTA ALREADY exists (hero: /signup self-serve + demo modal) — 3rd false-positive from incomplete grep; did NOT add a redundant CTA.
newCandidates: case-study-pipeline (testimonials/social proof — landing lacks it; HIGH conversion, needs real customer quotes)
outcomes.lesson: Verify before editing high-traffic pages: the landing already had the dual CTA the watchdog 'found' missing. The real conversion gaps now are (a) social proof/testimonials (needs real customer quotes), (b) data connectors (GSC/GA4) — both gated on inputs you provide. The single biggest unblock is provisioning analytics, so I shipped the concrete setup doc.
